description: This file defines the WithNode class, which represents a nested 'with' scope in the Twig templating engine. It handles the compilation of the 'with' tag to PHP code, managing scope variables and context.

classes.name: WithNode
classes.description: Represents a nested 'with' scope within Twig templates, managing context variables and compilation logic for the 'with' tag.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the WithNode with body, variables, scope flag, and line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to implement the 'with' scope, handling variables, scope isolation, and context restoration.
